y-m-53-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƙima guda a cikin zangon da kake ganin ita ce mafita da kuma ƙima guda a wajensa cikin asalin rashin daidaito, sannan ka duba ko ya tabbata.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.hint.1: Duba alaƙar alkiblar da −2x ke raguwa da alkiblar da x ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.r.a: Duba abin da ke faruwa da alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito idan aka raba ɓangarorin biyu da lamba mara kyau.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.r.b: Sake duba alamar ƙimar −10 da aka raba da −2.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.r.c: Za ka iya tabbatar da sakamakon ta saka 6 a madadin x ka duba ko rashin daidaito ya tabbata.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.r.d: Saka x=−6 a cikin rashin daidaiton, sannan ka duba ko ya tabbata.
y-m-53-08.s.s1.explain: Daga −2x+1<−9, muna samun −2x<−10; raba da lamba mara kyau −2 yana juya alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito, saboda haka x>5. Saka x=6 yana ba da −12+1=−11<−9, wanda ya tabbata; saka x=4 yana ba da −7<−9, wanda bai tabbata ba.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.prompt: Samar da rashin daidaito 3 daban-daban ax+b<c waɗanda mafitar su daidai x>3 ce, sannan ka shigar da a, b, c. (a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne. Cikakkiyar ƙimar a ba ta wuce 10 ba, ta b ba ta wuce 20 ba, ta c kuma ba ta wuce 100 ba.)
y-m-53-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo daya a, b, c wanda maganin ax+b=c shine 3.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika abin da zai faru da alƙawarin alamar rashin daidaituwa lokacin da kuka warware ax+b<c tare da waɗannan a, b, c, kuma sanya ƙima ɗaya don bincika cewa mafita shine x>3.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Ya dace da kewayon da yanayin lamba.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, c dole ne su zama lamba tare da a≠0, |a|≤10, |b|≤20, |c|≤100.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙimar x ba ta da kyau.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Tare da wannan a, jagoran mafita ba zai iya zama x>3 ba. Yi tunani game da lamarin inda jagorancin alamar rashin daidaituwa ya canza.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Iyakar maganin ba 3. Daidaita a, b, c ta yadda x mai gamsarwa ax+b=c ya zama 3.
y-m-53-08.s.s2.explain: Daga ax + b <c muna samun ax <c-b, kuma idan a <0, rarraba bangarorin biyu ta hanyar juyawa alamar rashin daidaituwa, don haka x> (c-b) / a. Muna bukata kawai (c-b)/a=3. Misalai: -x <-3, -2x+1<-5, -3x+2<-7.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.prompt: Za ku iya yin maganin x>3 tare da ax+b<c wanda rashin daidaituwa a cikin x yana da inganci? Rubuta ko zai yiwu ko a'a da dalili.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi rashin daidaituwa ɗaya tare da tabbataccen a, kamar a = 2, b=1, c=7, warware shi kai tsaye, kuma duba hanyar mafita.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ko mafita ya fito a hanya guda don wasu 'yan rashin daidaituwa tare da tabbatacce a.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin kun faɗi abin da zai faru da alkiblar alamar rashin daidaituwa lokacin da kuka raba ɓangarorin biyu ta lokacin da a ke da kyau?
y-m-53-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin kun duba shi da takamaiman misali (kamar 2x+1<7)?
y-m-53-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin kun san cewa yana yiwuwa tare da wata alamar rashin daidaituwa kamar ax+b>c?
y-m-53-08.s.s3.model.0: Ba shi yiwuwa. Idan a yana da kyau, to, raba bangarorin biyu ta hanyar a yana kiyaye alƙawarin alamar rashin daidaituwa, don haka yana ɗaukar nau'in x<(c-b)/a, kuma bayani kamar x>3 ba ya fitowa.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.model.1: Ba za a iya yi ba. Idan a> 0, maganin yana da nau'i x<wasu lamba, wanda shine akasin alkibla daga x>3, wanda ke tafiya zuwa dama ba tare da ƙarewa ba. Misali, 2x+1<7 yana bada x<3.
y-m-53-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Zai fi kyau a ƙara cewa idan kun canza alamar zuwa>, yana yiwuwa ko da tare da a> 0.

y-m-53-01.title: Idan aka saka lambobi a madadin haruffa, shin furucin biyun kullum daidai suke?
y-m-53-01.topic: Furuci masu haruffa: lokacin da furuci biyu suka daidaita da misalan ƙaryatawa.
y-m-53-01.goal: Zaɓi ƙimomin da ke karya da’awar “yana aiki ga duk ƙimomi” ka yi amfani da su a matsayin misalan ƙaryatawa, sannan tara ƙimomin da suka dace bisa sa’a ka hasashen sharadinsu na gama gari.
y-m-53-01.material: Sua ta rubuta wannan a littafinta: “Ga kowace lambar ainihi a da b, (a+b)² da a²+b² daidai suke.” (a+b)² na nufin “murabba’in jimillar a da b”, a²+b² kuma “murabba’in a da murabba’in b”. Duba ko wannan da’awa kullum daidai ce; idan ba haka ba, ga waɗanne ƙimomi take daidai?
y-m-53-01.thinking.0: Warware misalan ƙaryatawa da yanayin da ya dace bisa sa’a.
y-m-53-01.thinking.1: Hasashen sharadi daga misalan da suka dace.
y-m-53-01.prereq.0: Wannan yana ɗauka an san ilimin lissafi na asali na makarantar sakandare (sake duba lambobi, furuci da ma’auni). H1 matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a samarwa; ba yana nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan darasi a aji na 10 ba, kuma tsarin makarantu ya bambanta.
y-m-53-01.prereq.1: Saka lambobi a madadin haruffa don nemo ƙimar furuci (matakin sakandare ƙaramar).
y-m-53-01.prereq.2: Ma’anar murabba’i: a² ita ce lambar da ake samu idan aka ninka a da kanta.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk gwaje-gwajen da ke nuna da’awar Sua ba ta aiki kullum. (Saka ƙimomin ƙasa a madadin a da b, ka kwatanta ƙimomin furucan biyun.)
y-m-53-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane gwaji, lissafa ƙimar (a+b)² da a²+b² dabam, ka rubuta su gefe da gefe.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.hint.1: Raba gwaje-gwajen zuwa waɗanda ƙimomin suka yi daidai da waɗanda suka bambanta.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.a: Waɗannan ƙimomi ne da furucan biyun suka ba da sakamako iri ɗaya. Daidaituwa ba ta goyon bayan da’awar kuma ba ta karya ta.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka zaɓi gwaje-gwaje bisa ko ƙimomin furucan suka bambanta. Idan ko ƙima guda ba ta dace ba, “kullum” ya rushe.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.c: Ko da ka tattara ƙimomi da suka dace, ba za ka iya cewa “kullum” ba. Dole ne a nemo ƙimomin da ba su dace ba.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.d: Ka gwada ƙimomin da jimillarsu 0 ce ma. Ba za ka iya ganin bambancin furuci biyu ba sai ka saka ƙimomi.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.explain: Idan a=1,b=2, to (1+2)²=9 kuma 1²+2²=5, sun bambanta; idan a=3,b=−3, to 0²=0 amma 9+9=18, sun bambanta. Akasin haka, ga a=2,b=0 da a=0,b=5 furucan biyun daidai suke. Ko da an tattara ƙimomi da yawa masu daidaita, ba sa tabbatar da “kullum”; ƙima guda da ta bambanta tana karya da’awar.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da (a,b) guda 3 dabam-dabam inda da’awar Sua ta dace bisa sa’a, wato ƙimomin furucan biyun sun daidaita. Kada a yi amfani da yanayin a=b=0, kuma girman lambobin biyu kada ya wuce 100. (Musanya a da b ana ƙirga misali guda.)
y-m-53-01.s.s2.hint.0: Duba abin da a da b suka yi tarayya a gwaje-gwajen da suka dace a baya (ƙimomi kamar a=2,b=0).
y-m-53-01.s.s2.hint.1: Saka sabbin ƙimomin kai tsaye cikin furuci biyu, duba ko sun daidaita da gaske, sannan shigar da su.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ba yanayin da duka sifili ba ne. [lambobi: 0]
y-m-53-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b duka sifili ne. Aƙalla ɗayansu dole ya zama marar sifili. [lambobi: 0]
y-m-53-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Girman (absolute value) na a da b dole bai wuce 100 ba.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Ƙimomin furucan biyu sun yi daidai.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ga waɗannan ƙimomi, (a+b)² da a²+b² sun bambanta. Lissafa su dabam ka kwatanta.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.explain: Tunda (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b², domin furucan biyun su daidaita ana buƙatar 2ab=0. Saboda haka suna daidaita ne kawai idan a ko b sifili ne, kamar 3 da 0, ko 0 da −4. [lambobi: 2, 2, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 4]
y-m-53-01.s.s3.prompt: Me za ka ce wa Sua? Ka yi amfani da misalan da ka tara yanzu a matsayin shaida cewa da’awar ba kullum gaskiya ba ce, sannan ka yi hasashe ka rubuta sharadin da furucan biyu ke daidaitawa.
y-m-53-01.s.s3.hint.0: Yi amfani da gwaji guda daga s1 na sama inda ƙimomin suka bambanta a matsayin misalin ƙaryatawa, sannan ka yi magana kan misalan da suka dace.
y-m-53-01.s.s3.hint.1: Duba wanne daga a da b yake sifili a cikin misalan da suka dace. [lambobi: 0]
y-m-53-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ba kullum gaskiya ba ne. ... Suna daidaita ne kawai idan ...
y-m-53-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafa kai tsaye ko furucan biyu sun dace (ko sun bambanta) ga ƙimomin da ka bayar?
y-m-53-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi duka “ba kullum ba ne” da “a wasu yanayi suna daidaitawa”?
y-m-53-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Idan ka faɗi sharadi, za ka iya ƙirƙiri wani misali da ya cika sharadin ka gwada shi?
y-m-53-01.s.s3.model.0: Ba kullum daidai ba ne. Idan aka saka 1 da 2, ana samun 9 da 5, sun bambanta. Idan ɗaya daga cikin biyun sifili ne, kamar 3 da 0, furucan sun daidaita. Faɗaɗa (a+b)² yana ba da a²+2ab+b², saboda haka da alama suna daidaita ne kawai idan ab=0. [lambobi: 1, 2, 9, 5, 0, 3, 0, 2, 0]
y-m-53-01.s.s3.model.1: Abin da Sua ta ce ba daidai ba ne. Idan aka saka 3 da −3, ana samun 0 da 18, sun bambanta. Da alama suna daidaita ne kawai idan samfurin sifili ne, kamar a ko b sifili. [lambobi: 3, 3, 0, 18, 0, 0]
y-m-53-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Haka ma za a iya hasashen sharadi daga misalai kawai, ba tare da faɗaɗawa ba.

y-m-53-04.title: Karanta rashin daidaito guda ta hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-53-04.topic: Rashin daidaiton layi mai absolute value: karantawa a matsayin tazara da raba bisa yanayi.
y-m-53-04.goal: Kwatanta karanta rashin daidaiton absolute value a matsayin tazara a layin lambobi da raba bisa yanayi, sannan nemo ka gyara layin da ya rasa sharadi a mafitar rarrabuwar yanayi.
y-m-53-04.material: x lambar ainihi ce. Yeongha da Bora sun karanta rashin daidaito |x−3|≤2 (“absolute value na x a cire 3 bai wuce 2 ba”) ta hanyoyi dabam-dabam. Yeongha ta karanta “tazarar 3 da x a layin lambobi tana 2 ko ƙasa”, Bora kuma ta warware ta “raba yanayin x−3≥0 da yanayin x−3<0”.
y-m-53-04.thinking.0: Kwatanta ƙarfi da raunin hanyoyin warware biyun.
y-m-53-04.thinking.1: Duba ko sharadi an rubuta shi tare a kowane yanayi.
y-m-53-04.thinking.2: Aiwatar da hanya ga wani rashin daidaito (yanayin alama akasin haka).
y-m-53-04.prereq.1: Ma’anar tazara tsakanin maki biyu a layin lambobi da absolute value (|a| tazara ce daga 0 zuwa a).
y-m-53-04.prereq.2: Warware rashin daidaiton layi (siffofi kamar x−3≤2).
y-m-53-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk x-ɗin da suka cika |x−3|≤2. Gwada ƙimomin kai tsaye ta karatun Yeongha.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane ƙima, nemo absolute value na ƙimar a cire 3 (tazarar daga 3), ka kwatanta da 2.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.hint.1: Idan akwai ƙimar da tazararta daidai 2, sake duba ko alamar rashin daidaito ≤ ce ko <.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.r.a: Nemo tazara tsakanin 3 da 0, ka kwatanta da 2. Ka ji kawai cewa ya kusa ba tare da kwatantawa ba?
y-m-53-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka kwatanta ko an haɗa ƙimar iyaka ma. Idan alamar “≤” ce, maki masu tazara daidai 2 ma suna ciki.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.r.c: Wannan maki yana tazarar 1 daga 3 zuwa dama. Ka nemo tazara ka kwatanta da mizani.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka yanke ko a haɗa ƙimar iyaka ta alamar rashin daidaito. Iyakacin dama ma haka yake.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.r.e: Wannan maki yana da tazara fiye da mizani. Nemo tazarar 3 da 6 ka kwatanta da 2.
y-m-53-04.s.s1.explain: Tazarar x=1,4,5 daga 3 su ne 2,1,2, dukkansu 2 ko ƙasa. Ga x=0 da 6 tazara 3 ce, ta wuce mizani. Mafitar ita ce ɓangaren layin lambobi mai tsawon 2 a kowane gefe na 3, wato 1≤x≤5. [lambobi: 1, 4, 5, 3, 2, 1, 2, 2, 0, 6, 3, 2, 3, 1, 5]
y-m-53-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a tsarin warware Bora da hujjarsa ta yi ƙaranci.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta sakamakon da ka samu a kowane yanayi tare da sharadin yanayin.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.hint.1: Saka x=10 cikin mafita ta ƙarshe ka gwada ko rashin daidaiton ya cika.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.line.0: Idan x−3≥0, wato x≥3, to |x−3|=x−3, saboda haka x−3≤2, wato x≤5.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.line.1: Idan x−3<0, wato x<3, to |x−3|=−(x−3), saboda haka −(x−3)≤2, wato x≥1.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.line.2: Haɗa sakamakon yanayi biyun a rubuta “x≤5 ko x≥1” yana ba da dukkan lambobin ainihi.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka mafitar rashin daidaito ita ce dukkan lambobin ainihi.
y-m-53-04.s.s2.explain: A layi na 3, dole ne a duba sakamakon kowane yanayi tare da sharadinsa. Na farko x≥3 da x≤5, saboda haka 3≤x≤5; na biyu x<3 da x≥1, saboda haka 1≤x<3; idan aka haɗa 1≤x≤5. “Dukkan lambobin ainihi” a layi na 4 ma kuskure ne domin a x=10, |10−3|=7>2.
y-m-53-04.s.s3.prompt: Karanta shi a matsayin tazara kamar Yeongha, nemo mafitar |x−3|≥2, ka faɗi amfanin karanta shi a matsayin tazara a wannan matsala.
y-m-53-04.s.s3.hint.0: Alama 3 a layin lambobi ka zana maki biyun da suke da tazara 2 daga 3.
y-m-53-04.s.s3.hint.1: Zaɓi maki guda don gwada ko “tazara 2 ko fiye” tana tsakanin maki biyun ko wajen su.
y-m-53-04.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Tazarar daga 3 aƙalla 2 ce, saboda haka ...
y-m-53-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka gwada ko rashin daidaiton ya cika a iyakokin tazarorin da ka rubuta, 1 da 5?
y-m-53-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi abin da zane layin lambobi ya sauƙaƙa, sabanin warwarewa ta raba yanayi?
y-m-53-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi amfani da “da” (duka) da “ko” (ɗaya daga ciki) daidai kuma dabam?
y-m-53-04.s.s3.model.0: Waɗannan lambobi ne da tazararsu daga 3 aƙalla 2, saboda haka x≤1 ko x≥5. Za ka iya sanya 1 da 5 a layin lambobi ka ga sassan waje, don haka ba sai an raba bisa yanayi ba.
y-m-53-04.s.s3.model.1: x yana da tazarar aƙalla 2 daga 3, saboda haka x ya kai 1 ko ƙasa ko 5 ko sama. Idan aka karanta shi a matsayin tazara, mafita tana bayyana kai tsaye a zane, kuma akwai ƙarancin damuwar manta sharadi.

y-m-53-05.title: Za mu iya nemo farashi daga rasit uku?
y-m-53-05.topic: Tsarin ma’aunin layi: shin sabon bayani yana yanke mafita?
y-m-53-05.goal: Koyi cewa ƙarin ma’auni guda ba lallai ya kayyade mafita ba, sannan ƙirƙiri sharadi da kanka da zai zama sabon bayani.
y-m-53-05.material: A shagon kayan rubutu, bari farashin fensir guda x원, na gogewa guda kuma y원. x da y lambobin ƙidaya ne, ba a ganin jerin farashi. Ana nuna rasit ɗaya bayan ɗaya. (Ba za a faɗi ainihin ƙimomi ba sai ƙarshe.)
y-m-53-05.thinking.0: Riƙe ko gyara hukunci yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-53-05.thinking.1: Bambanta adadin ma’aunai da yawan bayanin da suke bayarwa.
y-m-53-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri sabon sharadi da zai kayyade mafita.

y-m-53-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana rasit ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki zaɓi hukuncinka ko za a iya sanin farashin fensir guda.
y-m-53-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane rasit, nemo aƙalla biyun (x,y) biyu da suka dace, ka duba ko biyun da ka riga ka samu suna dacewa da sabon rasit ma.
